pr_body:
* Add DMAMUX configuration for STM32H7.
* Fixes #5619
pr_comments: FWIW this patch has been tested on H7, dma_nohal is only used from DAC, without this patch it doesn't work the DMAMUX must be configured (see STM32H7 HAL_DMA_Init()), before that I was using the workaround in #5619
Thanks for this, merged in a32a7421d668c355629f28275eb756068633c41a

issue_context.title: STM32H7 DAC write_timed is not working.

review_comments: So this BDMA part of the code should never be enabled?

TL;DR: No I only left this code here because it should be correct and will be useful if/when BDMA is supported, if you prefer I can remove it. 

Long answer: It can be enabled since there are no BDMA streams currently defined so this path will never run, but first the handle in `dma_descr_t` must be changed to `void *` (or use a union) because BDMA uses a different typedef...
```c
    struct _dma_descr_t {
    #if defined(STM32F4) || defined(STM32F7) || defined(STM32H7)
    void *instance; /// DMA_Stream_TypeDef or BDMA_Channel_TypeDef
 ````
This should work fine for both, in `dma_nohal_init` we can define another handle for BDMA.. This will only make it build but to actually make it useful and support BDMA we also need to fix `dma_nohal_deinit` and probably `dma_nohal_start` to handle BDMA... Also there are no `dma_descr_t` streams defined for BDMA we can start to add some (it's in D3 has access to all D3 memories and peripherals ex: SRAM4, SAI4 etc..) finally we need to add BDMA IRQ handlers.
Ok, let's leave this code in then.
